ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by task-model fit. The query is a bounded, well-specified design task with explicit constraints ("don't overcomplicate," "get it right"), not open-ended creative generation. Lapwing scores higher on instruction-following (IFEval 90.4 vs 85.6) and reliably tracks multi-part constraints, while Whimbrel occasionally drops constraints. There's no harm-adjacent content that would make Whimbrel's moderation-oriented tuning relevant, so Lapwing's stronger general capability and constraint-handling made it the better match.
